kind: AI generated target UX concepts; not runtime screenshots; fictional data
commonStyle: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a single final high-fidelity product UI concept for the SAME coherent product named АВИТОЛОГ. Design language: futuristic premium decision cockpit, restrained and very usable, dark obsidian #0a1013, graphite panels #111b20, primary acid-lime #bcf57c, icy cyan #78dbe8 for evidence, soft off-white type, subtle technical depth, elegant fine borders and grids, generous spacing, precise icons, clean readable Russian typography. It should feel like a sophisticated near-future professional product, never a generic template, hacker terminal, poster, neon nightclub or decorative sci-fi HUD. Realistic controls, clear hierarchy, one main action. Match the architecture of a local-first browser extension plus full workspace. Flat front-on UI screenshot composition, no laptop, no perspective, no physical room, no watermark. This is one screen, not a collage or multiple screens. Desktop screens in widescreen 16:10; mobile screen in portrait. All displayed data fictional.

screens.title: Редактируемый бриф покупки
screens.prompt: Create one polished desktop product screen for АВИТОЛОГ, focused on EDITING BUYING INTENT. Use a large, calm form in the center and a compact live requirements summary on the right, within the shared application shell. Clear Russian heading: «Задача поиска». Fields: «Рост, см» 196, «Колёса» 29″, «Бюджет покупки» до 60 000 ₽, «Объявления» 30–90 тыс. ₽, «Отправная точка» Пролетарская. Separate essential requirements from preferences with labeled controls; include a short editable natural-language brief. One primary button: «Сохранить задачу». Show persistent «КОНЦЕПТ · СИНТЕТИЧЕСКИЕ ДАННЫЕ». This is a precise working form, not a landing page, onboarding carousel, or chatbot conversation. Do not imply that a live Avito search has run.

screens.title: Радар сохранённых кандидатов
screens.prompt: Create one desktop АВИТОЛОГ screen centered on a BICYCLE CANDIDATE GRID. Heading «Мой радар», a useful search input, suitability filter, selectable product cards, and one primary action «Сравнить выбранные». Show realistic generated 29-inch hardtail bicycle illustrations for synthetic Trail 29 XL variants A, B, C, priced 52 000 ₽, 59 000 ₽, 55 000 ₽. Cards have readable price, frame and wheel chips, location marked conditional, and text statuses such as «Нужно уточнить». One secondary card may have missing frame information, making the collection feel like a real evaluation workflow. Use explicit selection checkboxes and restrained status icons. Keep persistent «КОНЦЕПТ · СИНТЕТИЧЕСКИЕ ДАННЫЕ». Present saved local examples; no live scanning animation, real listing count, savings promise, or fake seller identity.
screens.corrections: Replace all suitability percentages with needs clarification.

screens.title: Сравнение трёх кандидатов
screens.prompt: Create one АВИТОЛОГ desktop COMPARISON screen with exactly THREE balanced candidate columns A, B, C and a fixed criterion column. Small generated bicycle thumbnails sit above concise rows. Heading «Различия, которые важны». Exact synthetic numbers: A price 52 000 ₽ + user reserve 3 500 ₽ = 55 500 ₽; B 59 000 ₽ + 4 500 ₽ = 63 500 ₽, explicitly «Выше бюджета»; C 55 000 ₽ + 4 000 ₽ = 59 000 ₽. Other rows show 29″ wheels, claimed XL frame, components and unknown service history. The reserve is labeled «Ваш резерв», not a diagnosed repair cost. Use text and icons for limitations. Primary «Открыть разбор». Persistent «КОНЦЕПТ · СИНТЕТИЧЕСКИЕ ДАННЫЕ». No numerical trust scores, winner trophy, verified fit claim or predicted discount.
screens.corrections: All three sellers are fictional private individuals.

screens.title: Ценовые ориентиры и аналоги
screens.prompt: Create one АВИТОЛОГ desktop ANALYTICS screen about ASKING-PRICE COMPARABLES, not completed sales. Heading «Ценовые ориентиры». Make a restrained dot plot with three independent synthetic observations 55 000 ₽, 57 000 ₽, 59 000 ₽, a clear range 55–59 тыс. ₽, and median 57 тыс. ₽. Do not use a time-series axis. Pair it with a readable included-comparables table and a method panel explaining matching group, wheels, frame and excluded target A. Show labels «3 демоаналога», «Цены объявлений», «Не цены сделок», and «Износ не учтён». Primary «Проверить аналоги». Persistent «КОНЦЕПТ · СИНТЕТИЧЕСКИЕ ДАННЫЕ». This is transparent arithmetic on saved examples, not a market-wide valuation, fair-price guarantee, profit forecast or measured saving.
screens.corrections: Match declared XL frame size; geometry unknown.

A left list contains saved synthetic buying cases; the center shows a small legible evidence graph for candidate A with only five or six named nodes such as «Карточка A», «Описание», «Аналоги», «Вопросы», «Решение». Heading «История решений», status «Выбор не сделан», primary «Открыть обоснование». Use navigable-looking list rows, source links and a sensible graph zoom control, not a decorative neural network. Persistent «КОНЦЕПТ · СИНТЕТИЧЕСКИЕ ДАННЫЕ» plus «Будущая возможность · граф». No real transaction history, cloud-sync claim, completed purchase or fabricated evidence.
